item.description: Chinese New Year Spring Festival or the Lunar New Year, is the festival that celebrates the beginning of a new year on the traditional lunisolar Chinese calendar. In the Chinese culture, the festival is also commonly referred to as Spring Festival as the spring season in the lunisolar calendar traditionally starts with Lìchūn, the first of the twenty-four solar terms which the festival celebrates around the time of the Lunar New Year.Marking the end of winter and the beginning of the spring seas
